results.name: S1 TEXT: all 806 Excel-cached TEXT() results in the corpus agree (number formats, dates, 1904 workbooks, booleans, sections)
S2 number formats vs Apache POI TestDataFormatter dfUS assertions (Excel behaviour; POI-only deviations listed in DESIGN-TT73): ≥ 163 of 189 agree (TT72: 120)
S3 external workbook links resolve from the cached externalLink parts: [1]Sheet!A1, [1]!Name, sheet-scoped [1]Sheet!Name, [0]!Name; a missing book is #REF!

S4 Unicode names: Лист2!A1 and 'Лист2'!A1, SUM(Лист2!A1:A3), a defined name Налог, and the Russian corpus workbook's SUBTOTAL(109,Таблица1[[Sum for Q1 ]]) = Excel's cached 19239.04 (TT72: #NAME?, lexer refused 'Т')

S5 Excel numeric-argument rules: refs count numbers only, literal text → #VALUE!, TRUE literal → 1, MODE with no repeat → #N/A, PRODUCT of no numbers → 0, ROUND digits truncate, TEXT(TRUE) without a 4th section

C1 FF-29 chart gate: every corpus chart series evaluates to Excel's own c:numCache / c:strCache — values (blank where Excel cached no point), categories / scatter x values and cached series names (lxml oracle)
H1 held-out formula probe: ≥ 26,869 of 26,946 Excel-cached formula cells agree after recalculation (TT72 baseline 26,295)

W1 header / footer picture: relationship in THAT part's .rels (not document.xml.rels), python-docx finds the image bytes, schema-valid, re-read shows it; Track Changes wraps it in w:ins; an existing header without xmlns:r on its root still gets a declared r:embed

W2 FF-22 Writer gate: EVERY readable corpus docx — text typed into the first body paragraph AND a picture added to its header — saves with no schema error the input lacked; python-docx opens every one and sees the typed text and the header picture; our reader re-reads both

N1 negative shapes (19): header-picture inputs (SVG / WebP / empty / text MIME refused; 0, negative, NaN, ∞ sizes clamped; markup and 10 000-character descriptions sanitised), external refs (missing book, missing sheet, missing name, a string literal that looks like a ref) and Unicode names (× ÷ 😀 unquoted, a name starting with an Arabic-Indic digit, A1 / R1C1 lookalikes)
P1 the PresentationML schema oracle is a real verifier: a fresh deck validates; a slide with an unknown p: element or with p:clrMapOvr before p:cSld is rejected

P2 FF-23 Slides gate: EVERY openable corpus deck — text box + preset shape + picture, speaker notes, a duplicated slide and a slide from a layout — saves with no schema error the input lacked (ECMA-376 pml.xsd via lxml) and python-pptx sees every edit
